_comment: Canonical manifest template for new consumers. Copied + customized by scripts/init-consumer.ps1. Per-install fields (contentHash, blockHash, depotRevision, pendingChangelist, lastCheckedAt) populated by install.ps1 on first run.

files.blockHashReason: Marker Specification implemented; AGENTIC-SCAFFOLD markers injected around the pre-existing append-fragment; blockHash = SHA-256 of the bytes between markers, cross-verified by validate-markers.ps1 and matching overlays/ue-perforce/p4ignore.fragment.

AGENTIC-SCAFFOLD generated-block markers placed around the unambiguously H2-delimited Codex Workspace Setup section (## Codex Workspace Setup .. before ## MCP Rules). blockHash = SHA-256 of bytes between markers, cross-verified by validate-markers.ps1 and matching the extracted source templates/codex/AGENTS.md. Reusable-core vs overlay decomposition of this block is a later Extract Reusable Core refinement and does not affect this hash.

AGENTIC-SCAFFOLD generated-block markers placed around the unambiguously H2-delimited Claude Code Workspace Setup section (## Claude Code Workspace Setup .. before ## MCP Rules). blockHash = SHA-256 of bytes between markers, cross-verified by validate-markers.ps1 and matching the extracted source templates/claude/CLAUDE.md. Markers are inert HTML comments; rendered bible content is unchanged. Reusable-core vs overlay decomposition is a later Extract Reusable Core refinement and does not affect this hash.

files.selfHashReason: Manifest content changes when file hashes are updated; validate schema and non-self entries instead.

notes: Schema v3 template for new consumers. Filter entries by selected -Overlays at init time.
localOnly entries are kept in the manifest for awareness; install.ps1 does not write them.
tool-capability overlay entries are kept regardless of -Overlays selection; they record deviations between tools.
After init-consumer + first install, this manifest becomes the consumer-owned installed manifest.
